about: Performance budgets (spec WP-102), checked by scripts/check-budgets.mjs after every production deploy. `weights` are exact, measured on what the page downloads: each is what the production runner measured on 2026-10-10 (after the lazy chat engine and the zod fix) plus 10-15% headroom — a ratchet: it only ever moves down, and a breach FAILS the check. `lab` are Lighthouse targets from the spec; they are noisy, so a breach only WARNS until the variance on a quiet runner is known (decision log D-027). Tighten a number by editing it here — never in code.
